title: Jellyfin founder Andrew leaves team
summary: Jellyfin founder and project lead Andrew (nyan-matt) announces departure from the open-source media server project after 7 years of leadership, marking a significant governance transition for the community-driven initiative.
problem_solved: Leadership transition and project governance continuity for a major open-source media server community
why_valuable: Highlights the challenges and importance of succession planning in open-source projects, affecting thousands of self-hosted media server users
